whatRemainsOpen: Accept-invitation side: this repo (hauska-map/property-explorer) has a GENERAL magic-link sign-in flow (requestMagicLinkEmail in src/lib/auth.ts, P-112) but NO invite-specific handling anywhere in this client -- no invite-token or query-param reading, nothing invite-aware in coldopen/SignUpCard.tsx or elsewhere (grepped for magicLink/magic-link/MagicLink/invitation.*accept/acceptInvit/invite.*token/inviteToken across src/, case-insensitive; the only real hit was the general P-112 sign-in flow). Two specific questions could NOT be verified from this repo because legacy-design-tools is not cloned here: (1) does createTeamInvitation actually send a magic-link email to the invitee via peMagicLink.ts/peMagicLinkEmail.ts, or does it only write the DB row; (2) does an invited person's ordinary sign-in get matched by email against their 'invited' roster row and flip it to 'joined', or does that need separate wiring. Neither is asserted as covered or as a confirmed gap -- both are named explicitly as unverified in the PR body for whoever has legacy-design-tools access to confirm.

The roster row's Revoke/Remove confirm button (data-testid=settings-team-confirm-remove) has no onClick handler -- pre-existing, found during this lane's reading of SettingsModal.tsx, out of this dispatch's named scope (a distinct write path: cancelTeamInvitation/removeTeamMember/patchTeamMemberRole), not touched.

The 400 error-shape contract (error: 'invalid_email' | 'invalid_role') is dispatch-asserted, not independently confirmed against legacy-design-tools source -- sendTeamInvite falls back to a generic error outcome carrying the server's own message/error string for any other 400 shape, so an unanticipated real-world error string still surfaces honestly rather than being mis-labelled, but the two named strings themselves have not been checked against the live route.
